name: bubble
title: Bubble
description: One message as a control-weight frame (2px, no radius) holding cells: the text, then files (Attachment layout="cell"). Consecutive bubbles attach on a 1px seam. Tone by role: plain (theirs), tint (yours), attention (not sent: the attention frame and an inserted ! cell). pending runs the Signal segment on the bottom keyline while it sends. Reactions sit on the bottom keyline.
